scheme_name: "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
description:
The "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" is a significant component of the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme." 

This scheme was launched by the Government of Assam on 1st April 2020. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to the tea industry in Assam. 

The Assam tea industry has been facing numerous challenges including fluctuating prices and rising production costs. 

The government aims to stabilize the industry by providing interest subvention on working capital loans. 

The specific goal is to enhance the competitiveness of Assam tea in both domestic and international markets. 

This initiative is expected to increase the production capacity of tea estates and improve the overall quality of tea produced in Assam. 

The scheme aims to benefit approximately 1,000 tea gardens across the state. 

Under this scheme, the government provides an interest subvention of 3% on working capital loans. 

This subvention is applicable for loans up to ₹5 crores. 

The interest subvention is available for a period of five years from the date of availing the loan. 

This means that if a tea garden takes a loan of ₹5 crores, they can receive a subsidy of ₹15 lakh annually. 

The total benefit over five years can amount to ₹75 lakh per tea garden. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and detailed. 

Only registered tea gardens in Assam are eligible to apply for the interest subvention. 

The tea gardens must have a valid registration under the Assam Tea Plantation Labour Act, 1951. 

Additionally, the tea gardens must be operational and engaged in the production of tea. 

The owners of the tea gardens must not have any outstanding dues to the government. 

The income of the tea garden must not exceed ₹10 crores annually. 

The application process for the interest subvention is straightforward. 

Tea garden owners must submit an application to the Assam Tea Board. 

The application must include details of the working capital loan availed from a financial institution. 

Required documents include a copy of the loan agreement and proof of registration under the Assam Tea Plantation Labour Act. 

Additionally, tea gardens must provide their annual income statement. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the Assam Tea Board. 

The board will verify the eligibility and the details provided in the application. 

If approved, the Assam Tea Board will issue a certificate of eligibility. 

This certificate must be submitted to the financial institution that provided the loan. 

The financial institution will then process the interest subvention as per the guidelines. 

The disbursement of the interest subvention is done on a quarterly basis. 

The first disbursement will occur after the verification process is complete. 

Subsequent disbursements will continue every three months. 

The Assam Tea Board is the primary implementing authority for this scheme. 

They are responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of funds. 

The contact details for the Assam Tea Board are available on their official website. 

The board can be reached via email or phone for any inquiries related to the scheme. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of Assam to support various industries. 

The Assam government has allocated ₹100 crores for the implementation of this scheme. 

This fund is aimed at providing financial assistance to the tea industry over a period of five years. 

The tea industry is a crucial part of Assam's economy, contributing significantly to employment and revenue. 

The state produces over 50% of India's total tea output. 

The Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme is designed to ensure the sustainability of this vital industry. 

The government has also introduced measures to promote organic tea cultivation. 

This is to enhance the marketability of Assam tea in international markets. 

The interest subvention scheme is expected to lead to an increase in the production of high-quality tea. 

The Assam Tea Board will monitor the impact of this scheme on the tea industry. 

They will conduct periodic assessments to evaluate the effectiveness of the interest subvention. 

This will help in making necessary adjustments to the scheme if required. 

The Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme is a proactive approach to support the tea sector. 

It aims to create a robust framework for financial assistance to tea gardens. 

The scheme is expected to improve the livelihoods of thousands of workers in the tea industry. 

The government encourages all eligible tea gardens to take advantage of this scheme. 

This initiative reflects the commitment of the Assam government to the welfare of the tea industry. 

The interest subvention on working capital is a crucial step towards revitalizing the sector. 

It aims to ensure that Assam tea remains competitive in the global market. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's efforts to support local industries. 

The Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme is a vital lifeline for many tea gardens. 

It is designed to provide immediate financial relief and long-term sustainability. 

The government is optimistic that this scheme will yield positive results in the coming years. 

It is an essential part of Assam's economic development strategy. 

The tea industry plays a significant role in the socio-economic landscape of Assam. 

The interest subvention on working capital is a strategic move to bolster this industry. 

The Assam government is committed to ensuring the growth and prosperity of the tea sector. 

This scheme is a crucial part of that commitment.
